profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, CA. Its website, centered on the Gemini product, describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, positioned to help with writing, planning, and brainstorming, and presented as an expression of generative AI capability. Google reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker GOOGL.

Google's tracked AI products span several categories. Gemini serves as its general large language model assistant, with Google AI Studio offered for model prototyping by developers. NotebookLM provides document-grounded research assistance by ingesting user-uploaded content. On the productivity side, Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI integrate Gemini into the broader Workspace suite, covering cloud storage, meeting summaries, live captions, and note-taking. Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are medical large language models aimed at clinical reasoning and healthcare data use cases, with a HIPAA BAA noted as required. TensorFlow and Keras remain Google's open-source machine learning frameworks, with TensorFlow Extended supporting MLOps workflows.

The held facts show no active litigation on record for Google in this dataset. A range of third-party MCP servers connect to Google services, including multiple Google Ads management servers, Google News, Google Search Console, Google Calendar, Google Forms, and Google Trends integrations, all built by external providers rather than Google itself.
